page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine operating on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile is driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor with a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The allocation provides 2 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs via multithreading, alongside 16.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM allocation. Processor cache configuration comprises 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX and AVX-512F.

The instance contains no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for operating system installation and persistent data stores. Dedicated hardware accelerators are not included, with a GPU count of zero. Network connectivity provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark testing highlights the performance characteristics of its older processor generation. Geekbench evaluation registers scores of 928.0 in single-core and 2014.0 in multi-core routines. In memory bandwidth evaluations, the platform demonstrates 21.27 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 18.88 GB/sec for large-block writes. Application workloads show Redis SET throughput reaching 2.87 million operations per second, gzip single-threaded compression achieving 18.97 GB/sec, and static web serving throughput measuring 2.52 GB/sec. Small 135M language model inference delivers 248.44 prompt processing tokens per second and 63.45 generation tokens per second.

Because the architecture demonstrates modest per-core throughput relative to modern processors, cost efficiency centers on balanced memory capacity rather than high compute performance. The ecs.sn2ne.xlarge instance fits general workloads that do not demand peak single-thread execution, including staging environments, continuous integration tasks, utility microservices, and lightweight back-office databases.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.xlarge is a general-purpose compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization, it provides 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores paired with 16.0 GB of memory, preserving a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The CPU features 35 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX-512F instructions. No local storage or hardware accelerators are included, with persistent data requiring external block storage. Network baseline bandwidth is set at 2 Gbps. Synthetic benchmarks place single-core Geekbench performance at 928.0 and multi-core at 2014.0, with large-block memory read bandwidth at 21.27 GB/sec and static web serving throughput at 2.52 GB/sec. The instance provides a balanced configuration suited for development environments, internal application services, background queues, and low-traffic utility workloads.
